verdict.rationale: Modal documents pay-only-for-what-runs billing: no charge for idle resources and endpoints that idle at zero. It also documents fast container spin-up/down and programmatic creation of Sandboxes and background work through its SDKs. Explicit programmatic stop, restart and terminate operations are not documented in the evidence, and scale-down appears platform-managed rather than user-invoked. Missing for 10: documented stop/restart/terminate APIs for containers or Sandboxes, explicit lifecycle-state control, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start, stop, restart, and terminate instances programmatically and keep paying only for what is running

citations.quote: You never pay for idle resources — just actual compute time, by the CPU cycle.
In contrast, _Modal spins containers_ up and down in 1-2 seconds.
Turn any function into an HTTPS endpoint that scales with traffic and idles at zero.
Create over a million Sandboxes in under a minute, and run up to 1M concurrently.
